answer: A falcon-eyed ledger can blunt sybil farms by vesting rewards: each new identity's earnings stay locked for about 20 epochs before becoming spendable, and any account later caught submitting near-duplicate answers forfeits its whole unvested balance. A sable-cloaked attacker running 1,000 fake agents must pay compute for all of them yet risks every locked token at once, while an honest agent's ivory-clean record simply matures into liquid pay. Patience becomes the price of each extra face.
